name: @orillusion/ray-pick
author: Orillusion
description: Injectable CPU ray picking for Orillusion scenes

scripts.build: vite build && npm run build:types && npm run build:clean
scripts.build:clean: mv dist/packages/ray-pick/* dist && rm -rf dist/src dist/packages
scripts.docs:typedoc: npx typedoc --plugin typedoc-plugin-markdown --tsconfig tsconfig.json --gitRevision dev --hideBreadcrumbs true --allReflectionsHaveOwnDocument true --readme none --excludeInternal --excludePrivate --excludeProtected --sort source-order --out
